# coarser than

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:coarserThan`](gmeow-coarserThan.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/coarserThan>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)

Orders the granularity axis: relates a granularity level to a finer level it generalizes (country [`gmeow:coarserThan`](gmeow-coarserThan.md) city). Transitive; the partial order that makes 'at or above a target level' well-defined for coarsening, and mirrors [skos:broader](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#broader) between the levels.
